description: This file provides helper functions for testing Flutter applications, including database initialization, widget pumping, and cleanup routines.

methods.name: initSqfliteFfiForTests
methods.description: Initializes the sqflite library to use the FFI implementation for testing, ensuring it is only initialized once.

methods.name: pumpFrames
methods.description: Simulates a fixed number of widget frames to ensure deterministic test progress.

methods.name: pumpAndSettleBounded
methods.description: Pumps frames until the framework is idle or a timeout occurs, with a fallback to pump additional frames to flush microtasks.

methods.name: unmountWidgetTree
methods.description: Removes the current widget tree and performs a bounded settle to cleanly reset the application state.

methods.name: disposeAppDependencies
methods.description: Performs cleanup of app dependencies such as canceling download timers and closing the database.
